description: Second sensitive-zone review pass. Reviewed status applies only to the bounded public protocol and its stated source/evidence boundary; it does not validate an entire legacy therapy collection or make the protocol equivalent to treatment.

dbt-distress-tolerance-coach.note: Reviewed against Dorset HealthCare NHS descriptions of DBT skills and the Valentine et al. systematic review of DBT skills training used without other DBT modalities. Public content is narrowed to a low-risk observe-pause-reassess exercise, removes cold-exposure/physiological instructions, and explicitly states that evidence does not make it equivalent to full DBT or crisis treatment.

dbt-distress-tolerance-coach.reason: The reviewed protocol notices an action urge, creates a harmless pause, and reassesses the next action. Emotion Regulation, Stress Regulation and Self-Awareness are the concrete Topics; DBT-derived identifies the sensitive source tradition and does not imply delivery of DBT treatment.
